shell_commands:
/usr/bin/zsh -lc "pwd
rg --files -g 'AGENTS.md' -g 'package.json' -g 'test-commands.yml' -g 'reanchor.mjs' -g '*message*' -g '*session*' | head -80
git status --short --branch
command -v lore-query-trace || true"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'cat AGENTS.md
cat .lore/test-commands.yml
cat package.json
cat src/types/messages.ts
cat src/index.ts
cat specs/hal-engine-websocket-protocol/spec.md
cat specs/hal-engine-conversation-list/spec.md'

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "cat .lore/test-commands.yml
cat src/types/messages.ts
rg -n 'messages|OutgoingMessage|IncomingMessage' src/index.ts
cat src/infrastructure/stores/sessionStoreListSignature.test.ts
cat src/types/sessionStore.ts
rg -n 'list_sessions|session_list|Conversation list|listFor' specs/hal-engine-websocket-protocol/spec.md src/types/messages.ts src/transport/ws/validation.ts src/transport/ws/messageHandler.ts"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "sed -n '80,125p' src/index.ts
sed -n '1,85p' specs/hal-engine-websocket-protocol/spec.md
cat jest.config.js
rg -n 'interface .*Frame|Frame\\b' src/types/messages.ts src/types/*.test.ts | head -50
rg --files scripts | rg 'spec|reanchor'"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "cat src/transport/ws/validation.ts
cat src/transport/ws/validation.test.ts
rg -n 'list_sessions|session_list' src/transport/conversationList.acceptance.test.ts
rg -n 'Session.*Message|client.*message|user_message|ping' specs/hal-engine-websocket-protocol/spec.md | head -50"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "sed -n '145,180p' specs/hal-engine-websocket-protocol/spec.md
rg -n '"'^### 4'"\\.' specs/hal-engine-websocket-protocol/spec.md
rg -n 'types/messages|validation.ts' specs/hal-engine-websocket-protocol/spec.md | tail -10
rg -n 'Unreleased|Added' CHANGELOG.md | head -12
ls scripts/spec-links 2>/dev/null || true"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "rg -n 'specs/.*#[0-9]+|spec:' src/**/*.test.ts | head -35
sed -n '1,20p' CHANGELOG.md
nl -ba src/transport/ws/listSessionsValidation.test.ts | head -12
rg -n 'spec anchor|specs/.*#|validated by' .lore scripts/lore-list-tests.mjs | head -50"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "cat scripts/lore-list-tests.mjs | head -100
rg -n 'specs/.*#[0-9]+|@spec|specAnchor|spec:' src scripts/lore* .lore | head -70"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'timeout 300 node --experimental-vm-modules node_modules/jest/bin/jest.js --runInBand --runTestsByPath src/transport/ws/listSessionsValidation.test.ts
git diff --stat
nl -ba src/transport/ws/listSessionsValidation.test.ts | head -7
git diff -- src/transport/ws/validation.ts src/types/messages.ts .lore/dod.md | head -180'

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "rg -n 'switch \\(.*type|message.type|data.type|IncomingMessage' src | head -85
rg -n '\\[validated by: accepts a bare request' specs/hal-engine-websocket-protocol/spec.md
git status --short"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'git add .lore/dod.md CHANGELOG.md specs/hal-engine-websocket-protocol/spec.md src/types/messages.ts src/transport/ws/validation.ts src/transport/ws/listSessionsValidation.test.ts
git commit -m "feat(transport): validate list_sessions frames"
git push origin HEAD'

/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'git fetch origin main
git merge origin/main
git status --short --branch
git rev-list --count @{upstream}..HEAD'
